t: Congratulations to the Russian men’s team, winners of the double mini-trampoline team event at the 2026 Trampoline Gymnastics World Championships in Nanjing, China
d: Vladimir Putin congratulated Alexander Butko, Ilya Penkin, Damian Kozmin, and Timofei Golubenko on their victory in the double mini-trampoline team event at the 2026 Trampoline Gymnastics World Championships in Nanjing, China.

t: Congratulations to the Russian women’s team on winning the tumbling team event at the 2026 Trampoline Gymnastics World Championships in Nanjing, China
d: Vladimir Putin congratulated Alexandra Lyamina, Yelena Neiman, Arina Kalyandra, and Polina Novolokina on their victory in the tumbling team event at the 2026 Trampoline Gymnastics World Championships in Nanjing, China.
